validity.recommendation: Correct LengthKnown from 1000 km to ~400 km (about 200 km onshore Rudan->Mobarak Mount + ~190-200 km subsea to Sohar); fill blank Diameter=56 in; keep Status review (see status_reviews: construction is premature).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well-documented project (Iran<->Oman gas export line, MoUs 2005/2013-15, Sept-2018 agreement; route later shifted to avoid UAE shallow waters). Multiple independent non-GEM sources describe it; not a phantom. CLASSIFICATION: correct as gas transmission export trunk (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission) - confirmed. DUPLICATE: checked against roster; NOT a duplicate of P3174 'Off-Shore Gas Pipeline' (P3174 = 1500 km / cap 1000, different profile) or the IGAT lines/Iran-Pakistan; distinct project, no relabel found. SPEC CONCERN (headline): GEM LengthKnown=1000 km is contradicted by 3 independent sources. offshore-mag (2016): '400-km pipeline ... land part 200 km from Rudan to Mobarak Mount ... seabed section to Sohar 200 km.' offshore-technology/GlobalData profile: '380km-long', 'maximum diameter of 56 inches'. Tehran Times (Sep 2024): ~200 km 56-inch land + 192 km 36-inch subsea (=~392 km). All agree ~380-400 km, none cite GEM. GEM's 1000 km is ~2.5x overstated - flag for correction, do not auto-overwrite. CAPACITY confirmed OK: GEM 10 bcm/y = 28 MMcm/d initial per offshore-mag, Tehran Times, offshore-technology (ultimate 42 MMcm/d) - leave as is. ATTRIBUTION note (minor): GEM Owner=Iran Ministry of Petroleum 100% (unref'd); offshore-technology lists operator 'National Iranian Gas Export' and owner 'National Iranian Oil and others' - NIOC/NIGEDC sit under the Ministry so not clearly wrong, but the exact owner entity is unconfirmed; did not stage an Owner [ref] since no clean independent source names 'Ministry of Petroleum' specifically (would be an orphan). ProposalYear=2003 (MISSING_REF): negotiations are generally dated 2005 MoU / 2013-15 agreement; could not independently corroborate 2003 specifically - left as-is, unref'd. SegmentCost $1.2bn: offshore-mag gives subsea construction cost ~$1.5bn (the widely-cited $60bn is the 25-yr gas value, not capex); GEM's $1.2bn is weakly supported - minor, not chased.

fills.researcher_notes: Diameter blank in GEM. offshore-technology/GlobalData: 'maximum diameter of 56 inches'; Tehran Times (Sep 2024): 200 km of 56-inch onshore pipe. Filling Diameter=56 in (the main/land+max diameter, 2 independent sources). CAVEAT: the line is dual-diameter - the ~192 km subsea section is 36-inch per Tehran Times; if GEM supports a multi-value diameter cell a human may prefer '56;36'. Left at single 56 (the dominant/max, and the only value both sources share) rather than fabricate a format.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: GEM records Status=construction with ConstructionYear=2023, but the defining subsea export line has NOT been built and physical construction has not begun. Newest project-specific evidence: Tehran Times (Sep 7 2024) quotes Omani Energy Minister Salim Al Aufi that the plan 'had been suspended for a long time' and would be implemented 'late 2024 or early 2025' - i.e. still aspirational, not under construction. offshore-technology/GlobalData profile labels the project 'upcoming' with operations 'expected to commence operations in 2025' (a slipping target). The 2023 attaqa/PressTV reports (the sheet's Status [ref], attaqa) only announced agreement to form a technical team / that construction 'has commenced' at the diplomatic level - not verified physical construction; the attaqa ref failed the value-in-page check for 'construction'. Iran International (2022) frames it as a 'proposed' pipeline requiring sanctions relief. RECOMMEND Status construction->proposed and clear/flag the unsupported ConstructionYear=2023. Searched EN + Persian (fardayeeghtesad Oct-2022: negotiations at initial stage, project suspended/pilot; naftema) and 2025-2026 news: found NO independent report that the late-2024/early-2025 target was met or that physical construction started; also no report of formal cancellation. Ongoing 2024 renewal talks keep it at 'proposed' rather than shelved for now, but note the long dormancy - if no 2025-2026 progress surfaces it trends toward the 2y->shelved dormancy rule. Not proposing shelved yet because active diplomatic engagement is <2y old (Sep 2024).

summary: P2225 Iran-Oman: real & correctly classified, no duplicate; STATUS concern (construction->proposed, subsea line never built, 'suspended'/'upcoming' per 2024 sources) + SPEC concern (Length 1000 km wrong, actually ~380-400 km); filled blank Diameter=56 in; capacity 10 bcm/y confirmed.
